stats.notes: Counts from Berkeley Admissions student profile (fall 2025 entry). Berkeley's CDS is published as a multi-tab Google Sheet that could not be machine-read for this import; C7/C9/C11 values pending manual entry. UC campuses are test-blind, so there are no SAT/ACT percentiles.

stats_extra.notes: Fall 2026 entry, from admissions student profile. Middle 50% of admits: unweighted GPA 3.90–4.00, weighted 4.36–4.72. 74% from public schools, 23% first generation.

cds_test_policy.notes: University of California does not consider SAT/ACT scores in admission.
